look_here_first: Look first at the short reproductive spike and then the leaves. Photograph or inspect the whole raceme with scale because this species can disappear among other stinging Tragia when only vegetative characters are used.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: reproductive measurements and raceme architecture are more reliable than general habit

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mature fruit is a small 3-lobed capsule typical of the genus

lookalikes.differences: Use the short raceme together with bract, pedicel, leaf-proportion, and fruit characters; vegetative habit alone is not secure.
